constraints.name: assessment_analysis_record_attempt_id_user_id_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id, user_id, version_id) REFERENCES assessment_attempt(id, user_id, version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: assessment_analysis_record_operation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES assessment_action(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: assessment_attempt_previous_attempt_id_user_id_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (previous_attempt_id, user_id, version_id) REFERENCES assessment_attempt(id, user_id, version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: assessment_attempt_snapshot
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SUBMITTED'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (snapshot_digest IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (submitted_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (((state)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['SUBMITTED'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (snapshot_digest IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NULL) AND (submitted_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: assessment_attempt_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['STARTED'::character varying, 'SUBMITTED'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'REVIEWED'::character varying, 'ABANDONED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: assessment_attempt_terminal_time
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REVIEWED'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying])::text[])) = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)) AND (((state)::text <> 'COMPLETED'::text) OR (completed_at >= submitted_at))))

constraints.name: assessment_attempt_user_id_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id, version_id) REFERENCES assessment_exposure(user_id, version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: assessment_completion_fact_attempt_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id) REFERENCES assessment_analysis_record(attempt_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: assessment_completion_fact_skill_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (skill_id) REFERENCES knowledge_skill(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_attempt_binding ON public.assessment_attempt USING btree (id, user_id, version_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_attempt_operation_id_key ON public.assessment_attempt USING btree (operation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_attempt_pkey ON public.assessment_attempt USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_assessment_attempt_owner_order ON public.assessment_attempt USING btree (user_id, created_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_completion_fact_pkey ON public.assessment_completion_fact USING btree (completion_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assessment_completion_source ON public.assessment_completion_fact USING btree (attempt_id, skill_id)
